decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's psychiatric core, is reimbursed by health insurers, and moved to the home page in 2024, which signals growing importance.
Senior living counseling has been featured on the home page in both years, is cheap to run, and channels clients into the firm's eldercare services.
The retail shop sells sheltered workshop products, supports inclusion goals, and was promoted to the home page in 2024.
Meal delivery for seniors is new and still has low visibility, but it uses the firm's existing kitchen capacity and meets rising demand from older adults living at home.
